invariants.rationale: Method is called with a context, and passing null would be an error in most reasonable API usages.
The instantTime is a timestamp string, likely required for the table operation; method likely assumes it is valid.
The operation expects a list of records to insert. Null records would not make sense and likely lead to an exception elsewhere.
The result of the insertOverwriteTable operation is expected to be a valid HoodieWriteMetadata object.
HoodieWriteMetadata should produce a non-null list of WriteStatus objects to represent the write results.
